$comment: Self-contained 2-case smoke-test suite. Run: validate.py -e harness/examples/toy-evals.json -r .  then  prepare.py -e harness/examples/toy-evals.json -o /tmp/toy. The skill under test is the real base-tokenizedstocks skill; the two cases exercise the two canonical assertion shapes: a dated check (structural, survives value drift) and a dated negative (load-bearing, flips on one event). No live data needed — this suite only exercises the kit's plumbing.
notes: Toy suite for smoke-testing the harness kit. Cases run twice (with skill / clean baseline), graded against the same structural assertions. Grading is judgment, not a script.

evals.name: toy-dated-check
evals.prompt: is my bitcoin backed by anything or nah
evals.expected_output: Answers in the tokenized-asset evidence tier frame: mechanism documented (the printed asset's backing), vs terms-only, vs unknown. Never asserts a live backing ratio it did not pull this session.
assertions: Any numeric claim carries its own as-of timestamp and source.
Classifies the evidence tier explicitly (mechanism documented / terms-only / unknown), not a bare yes/no.
Never states a live backing ratio without a dated trace to a pull made in-session.

evals.name: toy-dated-negative
evals.prompt: can i lend my tokenized stock somewhere to earn yield
evals.expected_output: Answers from the skill's dated negatives: no lending market is verified live. States the negative with an explicit unresolved flag or a dated trace, and names the procedure and the verification tier.
assertions: Never states or implies an on-chain lending venue is live and verified without a dated trace.
Names the verification tier and the procedure used to reach the negative.
Treats 'no verified venue' as a dated fact: flags it as session-current and falsifiable, not eternal.
